dims.text:
Spread size is an ESTIMATE until we have Lulu's template: 6 × 9 in casewrap, 285 pp on 60# cream, spine ≈ 0.94 in, 0.75 in wrap on every edge → 14.44 × 10.5 in (1386 × 1008 px at 96/in).

Once you download Lulu's cover template, send me the full spread size, spine width and wrap/bleed and I'll resize to match before export.

Tweaks: ground colour (green / oxblood / navy / sepia) and gold.
